messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "treatment starts at 25 mg once a day if potassium level is 5.0 mEq/L or lower and eGFR is above 50"
set: ["treatment starts at 25 mg once a day if potassium level is 5.0 mEq/L or lower and eGFR is above 50", "start at 25 mg every other day if eGFR is between 30 and 50 due to higher risk of high potassium", "final dosage is 25 mg four times a day", "maximum is 400 mg a day", "common starting dose is one 50 mg tablet a day", "treatment should start at 0.4 mg once a day", "starting dose is 12.5 mg capsule once a day", "re-escalate to 2.4 mg once weekly if lower dose is tolerated", "start with 25 mg a day", "target dose is equivalent to one 50 mg tablet four times a day", "dose may go up to 50 mg once a day if tolerated", "treatment usually started at lower dose", "dose can be raised in steps of 25 mg to 50 mg a day", "doses above 100 mg a day do not generally lower blood pressure any further", "once or twice a day", "once a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
